Perfect! Now I have enough information to provide a comprehensive overview. Let me compile my findings:

## COMPREHENSIVE PROJECT OVERVIEW: NeverGiveUp

### 1. PROJECT TYPE
**Unity Game Project** (Unity 6000.0.68f1 - Latest LTS)
- Desktop/Multi-platform capable with Mobile rendering support
- Uses Universal Render Pipeline (URP)
- C# game development with modern architecture patterns

---

### 2. OVERALL FOLDER STRUCTURE

```
NeverGiveUp/
├── Assets/
│   ├── _Base/                          # Reusable framework (DO NOT MODIFY FOR NEW PROJECTS)
│   │   ├── Scripts/Core/               # Core framework modules (DI, StateMachine, EventBus, Value)
│   │   ├── Scripts/Utilities/          # Helper utilities (Game, UI, Attributes, Editor)
│   │   ├── Res/                        # Resources (Effects, Shaders, Plugins)
│   │   ├── CLAUDE_BASE.md              # Framework template documentation
│   │   └── README.md                   # Framework setup & usage guide
│   ├── Scenes/
│   │   └── SampleScene.unity           # Single demo scene (empty/placeholder)
│   ├── Settings/                       # URP/rendering profiles
│   ├── TutorialInfo/                   # Unity template info (tutorial setup)
│   └── (Missing: _Game/ directory)    # ⚠️ WHERE GAME LOGIC SHOULD GO
├── Packages/
│   └── manifest.json                   # Project dependencies (VContainer, UniTask, URP, etc.)
├── ProjectSettings/                    # Unity project configuration
├── Library/                            # Unity cache (generated, ignore)
├── Logs/                               # Build/debug logs
├── Temp/                               # Temporary build files
├── .vscode/                            # VS Code configuration
├── .idea/                              # Rider IDE configuration
├── NeverGiveUp.slnx                    # Solution file for C# IDE
└── Assembly-CSharp*.csproj             # C# project files
```

---

### 3. KEY PROJECT CHARACTERISTICS

**Project Status:** Framework template with minimal game content
- **C# Scripts:** 33 files total
  - **Framework scripts:** 31 files in `_Base/Scripts/`
  - **Game scripts:** 2 files in `TutorialInfo/` (template-only)
  - **Game-specific code:** NONE (ready to be created)
- **Scenes:** 1 scene (`SampleScene.unity`) - empty/placeholder
- **Prefabs:** 1 prefab (`VFX_snow.prefab` - demo effect)
- **Total Assets Size:** 0.41 MB (minimal, very clean)
- **Unity Version:** 6000.0.68f1 (latest)
- **Rendering:** URP (mobile + PC optimized profiles)

---

### 4. FRAMEWORK ARCHITECTURE (The _Base Stack)

This project uses a sophisticated custom framework built on **4 pillars:**

#### **A. Dependency Injection (VContainer)**
- **File:** `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/DI/`
- **Classes:** `CtrlBase`, `GameCtrlBase`, `SceneCtrlBase`
- **Purpose:** Centralized dependency registration per scene
- Each scene has a `Ctrl` (Controller) that acts as both:
  1. DI Container/Scope manager
  2. StateMachine host
- **Hierarchy:**
  ```
  GameCtrl (GameCtrlBase) — Boot scene, DontDestroyOnLoad
      └── [SceneCtrl] (SceneCtrlBase) — Each gameplay scene
  ```

#### **B. State Machine (Custom)**
- **File:** `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/StateMachine/`
- **Classes:** `StateMachine<TStateType>`, `StateBase`, `StateCtrlBase`, `StateMachineBuilder`
- **Purpose:** Manage scene/entity flow with clear state transitions
- **Lifecycle per state:** `OnEnter() → OnUpdate()/OnFixedUpdate()/OnLateUpdate() → OnExit()`
- Fully generic - works with any enum as state key
- **Nesting:** States can contain their own nested StateMachine (`StateCtrlBase`)

#### **C. Event Bus (Custom)**
- **File:** `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/EventBus/EventBus.cs`
- **Classes:** `GameBus` (game-wide), `SceneBus` (scene-scoped)
- **Purpose:** Pub/sub messaging between decoupled systems
- Messages are **structs** (zero-allocation, zero-null)
- Auto-cleanup when scene unloads (prevents dangling listeners)
- **Usage:** `bus.Send<T>()`, `bus.On<T>(handler)`, `bus.Off<T>(handler)`

#### **D. Reactive Values**
- **File:** `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/Value/Value.cs`
- **Class:** `Value<T>`
- **Purpose:** Bind model data to UI with automatic updates
- `On()` callback immediately fires with current value
- **Usage:** UI observes `score.JumpCount.On(UpdateUI)`

---

### 5. KEY FILES & DOCUMENTATION

**Framework Documentation** (Vietnamese, excellent):
- `Assets/_Base/CLAUDE_BASE.md` — Project setup template (copy to root as `CLAUDE.md`)
- `Assets/_Base/README.md` — Complete framework guide with examples
- `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/DI/README.md` — DI patterns & scope rules
- `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/StateMachine/README.md` — State machine usage
- `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/EventBus/README.md` — Event bus patterns
- `Assets/_Base/Scripts/Core/Value/README.md` — Reactive value binding

**Project Configuration:**
- `.vscode/settings.json` — IDE exclusions (hide Library/, Temp/, etc.)
- `Packages/manifest.json` — Dependency list (see below)
- `ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt` — Unity 6000.0.68f1

---

### 6. PROJECT DEPENDENCIES

```json
Core Frameworks:
- com.cysharp.unitask                      # Async/await (vs coroutines)
- jp.hadashikick.vcontainer @ 1.17.0       # DI container
- com.unity.render-pipelines.universal     # URP (mobile-friendly)

UI/Graphics:
- com.unity.ugui @ 2.0.0                   # Built-in UI
- com.unity.timeline @ 1.8.10               # Animation/sequencing
- com.unity.visualscripting @ 1.9.7         # Visual scripting option

Developer Tools:
- com.unity.ide.rider @ 3.0.39              # JetBrains IDE integration
- com.unity.ide.visualstudio @ 2.0.27       # Visual Studio integration
- com.unity.inputsystem @ 1.18.0            # New Input System

Other:
- com.unity.ai.navigation @ 2.0.10          # NavMesh/Pathfinding
- com.unity.collab-proxy @ 2.11.3           # Collaborate (cloud)
- com.unity.test-framework @ 1.6.0          # Unit testing
```

**Missing (should add):**
- ✅ Mentioned in `CLAUDE_BASE.md` but NOT in manifest.json:
  - `com.unity.addressables @ 2.8.1` — Asset management (needed!)

---

### 7. CURRENT STATE & WHAT'S DONE vs. WHAT'S MISSING

**DONE (Framework Complete):**
✅ Framework architecture fully implemented & documented
✅ DI, StateMachine, EventBus, Value<T> ready to use
✅ Utility classes: SceneLoader, ObjectPool, PopupManager, etc.
✅ Editor utilities: Button attributes, ShowIf inspector conditions
✅ URP rendering profiles (Mobile + PC)
✅ VS Code & Rider IDE setup
✅ Project uses modern C# with UniTask (no coroutines)
✅ Excellent Vietnamese documentation for all modules

**MISSING (Needs Implementation):**
❌ **No `_Game/` folder** — where actual game logic should live
❌ **No GameCtrl implementation** — boot scene controller needed
❌ **No scene-specific controllers** — HomeCtrl, GameplayCtrl, etc.
❌ **No game states** — PlayingState, WinState, LoseState, etc.
❌ **No game features** — Player, Enemy, Score system, UI screens, etc.
❌ **Addressables not installed** — framework mentions it but not added
❌ **SampleScene is empty** — needs proper setup with GameCtrl
❌ **No unit tests** — test-framework installed but no tests written

---

### 8. RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS

1. **Create CLAUDE.md** at project root (copy from `CLAUDE_BASE.md`, update project name)
2. **Create _Game/ folder structure:**
   ```
   Assets/_Game/
   ├── Scripts/
   │   ├── Installers/    # GameCtrl, [Scene]Ctrl implementations
   │   ├── States/        # Game-specific states
   │   ├── Entities/      # Player, Enemy, etc.
   │   ├── Services/      # Game logic services
   │   └── UI/            # UI screens & popups
   ├── Prefabs/           # Game objects
   └── Resources/         # Textures, audio, data
   ```
3. **Implement GameCtrl** (boot scene entry point)
4. **Create first gameplay scene** with SceneCtrl
5. **Add Addressables package** (framework documentation recommends it)
6. **Populate SampleScene** with GameCtrl GameObject and proper setup

---

### 9. TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS

**Architecture Strengths:**
- Zero coupling between systems (DI + Bus pattern)
- Memory efficient (struct messages, caching, object pooling)
- Fully testable (all dependencies injectable)
- Scalable (nested state machines, multi-scene support)
- Performance optimized (UniTask async, URP rendering, memory cleanup)

**Code Quality:**
- Well-documented (every module has README)
- Follows SOLID principles
- Vietnamese comments explain "why", not just "what"
- No GameObjects scattered - all managed via DI

**Project Ready For:**
- Mobile games (mobile URP profiles)
- Desktop games (PC URP profiles)
- Puzzle games, action games, narrative games (SM handles any flow)
- Multiplayer (framework supports NetworkHelper utility)

---

### SUMMARY

**NeverGiveUp** is a **production-ready framework template** for building games in Unity. It has a complete, well-architected foundation but **zero game content**. The developer has created an excellent infrastructure but hasn't yet built the actual game. The next phase is implementing game-specific logic in a new `_Game/` folder following the established patterns.

# Base Framework — Context cho AI

> **Hướng dẫn setup project mới:**
> 1. Copy file này ra thư mục gốc project, đổi tên thành `CLAUDE.md`
> 2. Xóa phần hướng dẫn này
> 3. Điền tên project vào chỗ `[TÊN PROJECT]`

---

## Dự án

**[TÊN PROJECT]** — Unity game dùng Base Framework.

- `_Base/` — framework tái sử dụng, không chứa logic game
- `_Game/` — logic game cụ thể của project này

---

## Stack

| Thư viện | Vai trò |
|---|---|
| VContainer | Dependency Injection |
| StateMachine (custom) | Quản lý flow scene và entity |
| EventBus (custom) | Giao tiếp giữa các hệ thống |
| Value\<T\> (custom) | Bind giá trị từ Model xuống UI |
| UniTask | Async/Await thay coroutine |

---

## Kiến trúc Scope

```
GameCtrl  (GameCtrlBase)    — DontDestroyOnLoad, tồn tại suốt game
                               GameBus tự đăng ký ở đây
    └── [SceneCtrl] (SceneCtrlBase) — tồn tại 1 scene, auto-dispose khi unload
                                       SceneBus tự đăng ký ở đây
```

Cần set **Parent** trong Unity Inspector của SceneCtrl trỏ về GameCtrl.

---

## 4 trụ cột — khi nào dùng gì

| Tình huống | Dùng |
|---|---|
| Class A cần dùng class B | **DI** — `[Inject]` |
| Object có nhiều trạng thái | **StateMachine** — `StateBase`, `ChangeState()` |
| 2 hệ thống giao tiếp, không biết nhau | **Bus** — `Send` / `On` / `Off` |
| Giá trị thay đổi cần cập nhật UI | **Value\<T\>** — `.Current`, `On` / `Off` |

---

## Convention

```csharp
// Ctrl = entry point của scene: DI + StateMachine + enum State
// ConfigureDependencies() — nơi duy nhất đăng ký dependency
// State luôn Lifetime.Singleton — StateMachine cache và tái dùng
// Message là struct — không allocation, không null
// On() trong OnEnter/OnEnable, Off() trong OnExit/OnDisable — luôn thành cặp
// Không để public field — dùng method hoặc Value<T>
```

---

## Folder Structure

```
_Base/Scripts/Core/
├── DI/             — CtrlBase, GameCtrlBase, SceneCtrlBase
├── StateMachine/   — StateBase, StateCtrlBase, StateMachineBuilder
├── EventBus/       — GameBus, SceneBus
└── Value/          — Value<T>

_Game/Scripts/
├── Installers/     — GameCtrl, [Scene]Ctrl
├── States/         — PlayingState, WinState, LoseState...
└── ...             — Player, Services, UI...
```

---

## Đọc thêm

- Setup từ đầu: `_Base/README.md`
- Chi tiết từng module: `_Base/Scripts/Core/[Module]/README.md`
